title: Link budget and link margin
idea: Add up the power, gains and losses in dB to see what arrives. Margin is how far that is above what the receiver needs.

lines: That sum, seen at the receiver, is the link budget
Link margin = received − the minimum the receiver needs
Receiver sensitivity depends on front-end gain, noise figure and bandwidth

compare.how: Transmit power plus antenna gains minus all losses, as seen at the receiver.
What arrives minus the weakest signal the receiver can use.
The weakest signal a receiver can copy. Set by gain, noise figure and bandwidth.

traps.wrong: The sum of antenna gains minus system losses
traps.why: It starts with the transmitter's power too.
Margin uses what actually arrives, after all the gains and losses, not the transmit power.
It matters, but so do the gain and the bandwidth: all these choices.
